movelist.name: Slash
movelist.effect: Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Sand Tomb
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Sandstorm
movelist.effect: The weather changes to a Sandstorm for 5 rounds. While it is Sandstorming, all non-Ground, Rock, or Steel Type Pokémon lose a Tick of Hit Points at the beginning of their turn.

movelist.name: Dragon Rage
movelist.effect: If it hits, Dragon Rage causes the target to lose 15 Hit Points. Dragon Rage is Special and interacts with other moves and effects as such (Special Evasion may be applied to avoid it, Mirror Coat can reflect it, etc.).

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. This is increased to +2 Evasion while in a Sandstorm or sandy terrain. While in a Sandstorm, the user and adjacent allies do not lose Hit Points due to the Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Frighten
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.
